case_name: Samraggi Mukherjee vs Word Power Commnications Private Limited and Another

parties.respondent_defendant: Word Power Commnications Private Limited and Another (Respondents)

facts_of_case: The parties are seeking a fresh application under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 for mutual divorce.

legal_principles.principle: A fresh application under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 is required before passing any order in an execution application.
legal_principles.held: Accordingly, hearing of this application is adjourned till June 30, 2010. If the parties file a fresh application for mutual divorce they would be at liberty to approach the learned District Judge at Alipore, South 24-Parganas for early disposal

legal_principles.principle: Parties must approach the learned District Judge at Alipore, South 24-Parganas for early disposal of a fresh application.
legal_principles.held: If the parties file a fresh application for mutual divorce they would be at liberty to approach the learned District Judge at Alipore, South 24-Parganas for early disposal

outcome.final_order: Hearing of this application is adjourned till June 30, 2010. If parties file a fresh application for mutual divorce they would be at liberty to approach the learned District Judge at Alipore, South 24-Parganas for early disposal of such application.
